why: A relaxed complex whose shape complementarity is far below the 0.55 floor: the binder and the ligand are not packed against each other. This is the gate doing its job on the metric it was given. Read it alongside backlog G5: our filter hardcodes <ShapeComplementarity jump="1"/> with the default scorefunction (rosetta_agents.py:104) while upstream uses explicit chainA/chainB selectors under beta_nov16. If the ligand is not across jump 1, the number scored here is of some other interface - in which case a LOW value is still informative but a HIGH value is not evidence of anything.
